# Jonah Kessler-Cohen

> A Seattle-based filmmaker and social media video producer at Loyola Marymount University. His work ranges from satire to documentary to branded content. Aside from projects, he's a moose enthusiast and a casual rock climber.

- Sophomore at [Loyola Marymount University](https://lmu.edu/), double majoring in Marketing and in Film and Television Production (class of 2029).
- Currently a student videographer for [LMU's library](https://library.lmu.edu/).
- Worked as a video/photo intern at [Sound Transit](https://www.soundtransit.org/) in Summer 2026.
- Generated 25M+ views across social media accounts he's run.
- Adobe Certified Professional in Premiere Pro; 6+ years editing in Final Cut Pro X.

## Portfolio

Top three projects, ranked by personal favorite; full descriptions and additional projects at [jonahkc.com](https://jonahkc.com/).

- [Sound Transit](https://jonahkc.com/portfolio/sound-transit): Video/photo intern, summer 2026. Filmed and photographed events and operations across the agency for internal and external use, including record-breaking ridership during the 2026 FIFA World Cup.
- [T-Mobile Club](https://jonahkc.com/portfolio/tmobile): Founded an appreciation club that toured T-Mobile's headquarters and was featured at a conference of 800 German executives, among other things.
- [Is there a whale season?](https://youtu.be/3qHCwG9p4Vw): Short documentary made as a college application film, filmed with his grandmother on Orcas Island.
